name: session-retro
title: Session Retro
summary: Turn a completed session's observed failures into improvements to the agent environment—navigation, checks, standards, tooling, and steering.

use_when: A session ended, especially one that went sideways, stalled, or repeated itself
The user asks what would have prevented a mistake or slowdown
avoid_when: The code itself needs fixing — use debugging or code-review
A production incident needs a postmortem — use incident-response
Work continues in another session — use session-handoff
